Bupropion Bupropion

ATC N06AX12 · Substance ID bupropion

Easily confused with：Buspirone（Buspirone busPIRone） FDA recommends tall-man lettering for this pair; check the ingredient, not the name. All pairs
The same ingredient can carry completely different brand names in different countries, and the same name can point to a different ingredient. Listed by country — not interchangeable.
